plugins.name: ScapeLite Core
plugins.author: Wulf
plugins.tagline: Everything essential, always on: settings, status light, panel tools, ScapeLite menu, tooltips, XP tracker.
plugins.description: The ScapeLite essentials in one always-on bundle: the Plugins tab inside Settings, the pulsing status light with live performance breakdown, the first-run welcome tour, Settings quick-jump menus, hover info on tooltips, the side-menu tab controls, panel resizing / locking / fusing with the vertical menu, and the XP/hr tracker with its live graph. Individual options live under Settings > Plugins. It also contains the Game Data Bridge: a read-only view of the game’s own numbers that the Route Advisor, Bank Tools, Crafting Potential, Combat Readout and Task Log rely on.
features: Plugins tab in Settings (switches, options, secret fields with an eye)
Status light: health, FPS and a per-plugin CPU breakdown on hover
Welcome tour (replayable) and Settings quick-jump menus
Hover info: XP, gold, slay and quest details on tooltips
Side menu tab controls (show / hide / pin icons)
Panel tools: resize, lock, right-click menu, vertical menu, keep on screen
Panel fuse: snap panels together, move and resize them as one
XP/hr tracker with a live graph, time frames, per-skill icons and level ETAs
Network hook for hiscores / raid summaries (read-only)
Saved logs: one file per run in the Logs folder, auto-cleaned (set how long to keep them)
ScapeLite button in the icon strip that opens your ScapeLite panels
Panels scale with the game window
Panels keep their place at the screen edges when the window is resized

plugins.name: Walking Countdown
plugins.author: Wulf
plugins.tagline: Real ETA for the current walk.
plugins.description: A small panel showing the remaining distance and a time estimate based on your measured walking speed (including speed potions), instead of a formula guess.
features: Measured speed
Detects speed potions
Resizable

plugins.name: Route Advisor
plugins.author: Wulf
plugins.tagline: Finds a faster order for your task queue, with or without teleports.
plugins.description: Simulates your queue with the game's real teleport-crystal rules and recommends the quickest order (keeping your option picks), both with and without teleports. Optimise for steps, XP/hr, tasks/hr or quest progress, preview routes on a map, and get an optional notification when a big saving appears. Display-only: you apply suggestions yourself.
features: Recommended with and without teleports
Objectives: steps, XP/hr, tasks/hr, quests
Map preview with every node and road
Purple border = teleports, blue = quest
Alternatives and pros/cons
Optional OS notification

steps.title: What it does
steps.body: It simulates your task queue with the game’s real walking and teleport-crystal rules and suggests a faster order (keeping the options you picked). It never changes your queue — you apply a suggestion yourself.

steps.title: Reading the plan
steps.body:
• Recommended · with teleports / no teleports: the fastest order in each mode. Choose your style with I plan with.
  • Purple border = the route uses teleport charges, blue = it involves a quest.
  • Pick an objective (steps, XP/hr, tasks/hr, quests) to optimise for something else.

steps.title: The warning tab
steps.body: A pulsing tab above your Tasks panel appears when a clearly faster order exists. Opening the Route Advisor dismisses it until the situation changes. The size of the saving that triggers it, and optional notifications, are in Settings → Plugins → Route Advisor.

steps.title: Needs the game bridge
steps.body: XP/hr and task-time numbers come from the game’s own projections through the Game Data Bridge, which attaches a few seconds after the game loads. If it says the bridge is not attached yet, wait a moment.

plugins.name: Map Route Lanes
plugins.author: Wulf
plugins.tagline: Readable overlapping routes on the World Map.
plugins.description: On the World Map, overlapping route legs are drawn side by side and chevron arrows show direction.
features: Parallel lanes for overlapping legs
Direction arrows

plugins.name: Notify While Focused
plugins.author: Wulf
plugins.tagline: Lets the game's OS notifications fire even while the window is focused.
plugins.description: The game normally only notifies when unfocused. This lets its (and ScapeLite's) notifications show regardless.
features: Works with Route Advisor notifications

steps.title: What it does
steps.body:
The game normally only shows desktop notifications while its window is in the background. This lets notifications (the game’s and ScapeLite’s) show even while you are playing.

Your system must allow notifications for the game: check Windows Settings → System → Notifications and that Focus Assist is not blocking them.

plugins.name: Chat Relay (Discord)
plugins.author: Wulf
plugins.tagline: Forward clan/global drops, unlocks and level-ups to Discord.
plugins.description: Collects Clan and Global announcements (rare drops, unlocks, level-ups) and posts them to your Discord webhook, with outbox and catch-up so nothing is lost across restarts. Also powers clan hiscores tracking, raid summaries and the activity digest. Needs overlay/chat-relay-config.json (see the install guide).
features: Clan / global relay
Never loses messages across restarts
Clan hiscores rank tracking
Raid summaries
Activity digest

steps.title: What it does
steps.body:
The relay posts your clan’s notable events to a Discord channel: rare drops, unlocks, level-ups, collections, quests, plus optional clan hiscores updates, raid summaries and an activity digest.

It runs on your PC and only sends what you set up here. You need a Discord server where you can manage webhooks.

steps.title: 1. Make a webhook in Discord
steps.body:
In Discord open your server’s Settings → Integrations → Webhooks → New Webhook.

Pick the channel it should post in, give it a name, then press Copy Webhook URL.

Treat the URL like a password: anyone who has it can post in that channel.

steps.title: 2. Paste it into ScapeLite
steps.body:
In the game open Settings → Plugins → Chat Relay and paste the URL into Clan Channel Webhook URL. Use the eye button to check it.

The URL is stored only on this PC. Do the same for the other sections you want (Clan Hiscores, Raid Summary, Activity Digest) — they can use the same or different channels.

steps.title: 3. Turn on what you want
steps.body:
Still in Plugins → Chat Relay: switch on Relay Clan Chat (and Global if you want it) and choose which pings to send.

Important: the relay only sees what the game itself shows in chat. In the game’s own Settings → Chat, make sure the Clan channel has the announcement types turned on (rare drops, unlocks, levels, collections, quests). If a type is off there, ScapeLite never sees it.

steps.title: 4. Optional extras
steps.body:
• Role pings and member list live in the config file (chat-relay-config.json in your ScapeLite data folder; an example file is included).
  • Ultra rare drops (Shiny / Lucky items) use a separate role.
  • Digest times: under Activity Digest you can add fixed posting times such as 08:00, 14:00, 20:00.

steps.title: If nothing arrives
steps.body:
• Open the ScapeLite dashboard and check the Discord log pane for errors.
  • A wrong or deleted webhook gives an error there; paste a fresh URL.
  • Make sure the plugin is on in the marketplace and the game shows the event in its chat.
  • The saved log files in the Logs folder show the same lines.

plugins.name: Clan Status Board (Discord)
plugins.author: Wulf
plugins.tagline: One live card per clan member in a Discord channel: what they are doing, level-ups, total level.
plugins.description: Posts one Discord card under your in-game name and keeps it up to date every 1 to 5 minutes: your current task with a progress bar and a finish time, level-ups from the last 24 hours, total level, and optionally XP per hour, HP, Slayer task, Fortress run, online-since and today's totals. Grey when you are offline ("last seen 20 minutes ago"), amber when idle. Off until you switch it on in Settings > Plugins > Clan Status Board; every field is its own switch and the settings page shows a live preview of the card. Display only: it reads your own state, never acts in the game. Read docs/CLAN-STATUS-BOARD.md for the setup and the privacy note.
features: One card per player, edited in place
Every field opt-in, with a live preview
Offline and idle states
Level-ups of the last 24 hours
Works with a plain Discord webhook, no bot

steps.title: What it does
steps.body:
Every clan member who joins the board gets one card in a Discord channel, under their in-game name. The card shows what they are doing right now, level-ups from the last day and more, and is edited in place every few minutes (no flood of messages).

It is display only: ScapeLite reads your own state and never acts in the game. Everything is off until you switch it on.

steps.title: Clan leader: make the board channel
steps.body:
Create a channel (for example #clan-board) that members can read but not write in. In Discord open the channel Edit Channel → Integrations → Webhooks → New Webhook, name it, and press Copy Webhook URL.

Who can change what: everyone who has this URL could, in principle, edit or delete any card posted through it. ScapeLite only ever edits its own card (it remembers the message id on your PC), but the URL itself is a shared key. You, the leader, decide who gets it: hand it only to members you trust, and make a new webhook (deleting the old one) if it ever leaks.

steps.title: Everyone: paste the URL and choose fields
steps.body:
In the game open Settings → Plugins → Clan Status Board, paste the URL into Board Webhook URL, tick the fields you are happy to show (the preview below them is exactly what Discord gets), then switch on Show My Card On The Clan Board.

The URL is stored only on this PC. Switch the board off again at any time; delete your card in Discord yourself if you want it gone.

steps.title: What is sent
steps.body: Only the ticked fields, built from your own game state, plus your in-game name: no account id, no gold or bank values, no chat, nothing about other players. Default fields: what you are doing, progress and time left, level-ups, total level. The more personal ones (HP, where you are, Slayer, Fortress, today's totals) are off until you tick them.

plugins.name: Raid Lobby Alert
plugins.author: Wulf
plugins.tagline: Notify when an open raid lobby fits you (experimental).
plugins.description: Watches open raid lobbies and notifies you when a strong party has a free slot. Read-only, never joins. Has cooldowns, an hourly cap and quiet hours; disabled by default.
features: Cooldown + hourly cap + quiet hours
Read-only

plugins.name: Menu + HP Bar Dock
plugins.author: Wulf
plugins.tagline: Move, resize and fuse the vertical menu and HP bar.
plugins.description: Treats the vertical bottom-right menu and the HP bar as one panel: drag its top strip to move it, drag the corner to resize it, and fuse it to neighbouring panels. When it is not on a screen edge, its buttons get rounded corners all round.
features: Drag strip to move
Corner grip to resize
Fuse with panels
Menu always paints above the HP bar

plugins.name: Resizable Windows
plugins.author: Wulf
plugins.tagline: Shrink the big Settings, Bank and Crafting windows.
plugins.description: Adds a corner grip to the game's full-screen windows. Drag it towards the centre to scale the window down (50-100%) so the game stays visible around it. The size is remembered per window.
features: Corner grip, 50-100%
Remembered per window
Double-click to reset

plugins.name: Notification Dock
plugins.author: Wulf
plugins.tagline: Invites and popups always on top, centred, and movable.
plugins.description: Raises the game's notifications (raid / party / friend invites, task-complete popups, toasts) above every panel and window so nothing can hide them. The invite tray, which normally sits in the top-left, is centred by default. Drag the strip above the invite tray, or use Move Notifications in Settings > Plugins to place all three; positions are remembered.
features: Always above panels and windows
Invite tray centred by default
Drag to move, remembered
Frames for short-lived popups and toasts

plugins.name: Bank Tools
plugins.author: Wulf
plugins.tagline: Category separators, item category chips and sub-category filters in your bank.
plugins.description: Draws a separator (with a small label) between every category in the bank grid, shows which categories an item belongs to when you hover it, and adds hover menus to the bank filter buttons: hover Raw to pick Fish, Mine, Forage and so on, and only those items are shown. Uses the game's own category rules.
features: Separator and label between every category
Hover an item to see its categories
Hover Raw / Processed / Equipment / Potions for sub-filters with item counts
Display only: your bank is never reordered

plugins.name: Window Buttons Dock
plugins.author: Wulf
plugins.tagline: Move, resize and tuck away the top-right button row; the cross closes the World Map.
plugins.description: The row of buttons in the top-right corner (language, support links, World Map, Patch Notes, Sleep, Logout) can be moved and resized from a small strip that appears under it. An arrow on the strip tucks the row into the nearest screen edge as a small badge. While the World Map is open, the cross button closes the map instead of logging out.
features: Drag to move, corner to resize
Arrow tucks it into the nearest edge as a badge
Cross closes the World Map while it is open
Remembered between sessions

plugins.name: Layout Presets
plugins.author: Wulf
plugins.tagline: Save named layouts of your panels and docks and switch between them.
plugins.description: Arrange your panels, docks and windows once, save them as a named layout (for example Questing, Raid or Clean) and load it again later. A layout covers panel positions and sizes, fuses, locks, the menu and window-button docks, notification positions, trackers and window sizes. Loading a layout reloads the game page. Open it from Settings > Plugins > Layouts.
features: Save, update, load and delete named layouts
One-click reset to the game default
Stored locally, never sent anywhere

plugins.name: Crafting Potential
plugins.author: Wulf
plugins.tagline: See the level you could reach by crafting with everything in your bank.
plugins.description: In the Smith, Craft, Imbue and Brew windows, the XP bar at the top also shows a striped gold section: the XP you would gain by crafting with every material in your bank (most XP-efficient recipes first). Within a level it fills part of the bar; when it is enough for whole levels the bar fills to the end and a row of level chips shows each level you would gain, with the progress into the last one.
features: Gold striped potential section in the XP bar
Level chips for multi-level potential
Uses the game's own recipes and your bank
Display only: nothing is crafted for you

plugins.name: Chat Default Channel
plugins.author: Wulf
plugins.tagline: Starts every session on the chat you actually use.
plugins.description: The game always starts the chat box on Global, even when Global is hidden. This plugin remembers the channel you last chose and applies it once after login; when that channel is hidden, or none is saved, it picks the leftmost shown channel (Global, Proximity or Raid, Friends, Clan). Anything you choose later is never overridden. It only sets which channel the text box sends to and never sends anything.
features: Remembers your last chosen chat
Falls back to the leftmost shown channel
Applied once per login, never overrides later changes

plugins.name: Mechanics Explainer
plugins.author: Wulf
plugins.tagline: Hover a lever and get a plain explanation of what the step does.
plugins.description: The weight and quantity levers in the Skills and Slay Customization windows only show a number and a cost. This adds a short explanation under the game's own tooltip: each step is 1.25 times as likely or as many, odds are shared with the other entries, and the cost doubles with each step away from zero. It uses the numbers already in the tooltip. Display only.
features: Explains weight and quantity levers on hover
Shows the multiplier now and after the step
Display only

plugins.name: Material Shortage Warning
plugins.author: Wulf
plugins.tagline: Warns before a task runs out of materials and falls back to scrap.
plugins.description: Checks the running task and every queued Smith, Craft, Imbue, Brew, Cook and Barter task against what you hold (bank plus inventory). Earlier tasks in the queue use materials first. Your chance to save materials is counted conservatively: only half of it by default, so a stretch of bad luck does not leave you short. A small panel appears only when something is at risk: red when you will probably run short (with the missing amount and the scrap that would be used), yellow when it only works out if your saves come in. Display only.
features: Checks the running task and the whole queue
Counts only part of your material-save chance (adjustable)
Shares stock between queued tasks that use the same material
Panel is hidden when everything is fine

plugins.name: Combat Readout
plugins.author: Wulf
plugins.tagline: Exact HP, Spirit, attack timer and DPS drawn on the combat scene's own bars.
plugins.description: Adds exact numbers to the combat scene's own bars: HP and Spirit as 57 / 80 for you and your target, the attack timer counting down on its bar, and under your bars the exact attack interval, attacks per second and your expected DPS using the game's own damage formula for the loadout the fight really uses (Auto Loadout included). Display only.
features: HP and Spirit numbers on the bars
Attack timer countdown on the bar
Exact interval and attacks per second
Expected DPS from the game's own formula

plugins.name: Anonymous Usage Data
plugins.author: Wulf
plugins.tagline: One anonymous request a day so the author can see how many people use ScapeLite.
plugins.description: Sent, once a day at most, to a privacy-friendly counter (GoatCounter): the page path /active, the ScapeLite version and, as with every web request, your IP address and browser/OS name (GoatCounter does not store the IP, it only uses it to count unique visitors). Never sent: your name, character, account, game progress or data, settings, plugin list, webhooks, or anything you do. No cookies are used and no ID is saved. It is on by default; you can switch it off in the first-launch setup or any time in Settings > Plugins > ScapeLite Core > Share Anonymous Usage Count. Nothing is sent before the first-launch setup has been answered.
features: One request per day at most
Version number only
Opt out in setup or in Settings

plugins.name: Task Log
plugins.author: Wulf
plugins.tagline: Records every task you run so the Route Advisor can be checked against real results.
plugins.description: Logs each task you complete: what it was, how long it took split into walking, acting and banking, the XP it really paid, and what the game's dashboard and the Route Advisor predicted. Everything stays in this browser profile; nothing is sent anywhere. Download it from Settings > Plugins > Route Advisor. The data is used to calibrate the advisor's time estimates, especially for combat.
features: Time split into walking / acting / banking
Real XP per task
Predicted vs actual time
Local only, downloadable as JSON

plugins.name: Task History Tooltips
plugins.author: Wulf
plugins.tagline: Rich hover tooltips on the Skills Customization history lists, and a Slay History that is never empty.
plugins.description: Hover a row of the history list in the Skills Customization window to see the real lifetime task number, how long the task took split into walking, acting and banking, the XP it paid per skill, what it dropped, which materials it used up, potion charges spent, gold, and planned versus actual. The game keeps no slay history (its Slay History view always says 0 tasks completed); this fills it from the Task Log. Display only.
features: Real task number, time split, XP per skill
Drops, materials used, potion charges, gold
Planned vs actual
Slay History filled from the Task Log

plugins.name: Lever Advisor
plugins.author: Wulf
plugins.tagline: Yellow outlines on the skill and slay levers worth pulling, by route, within your credits.
plugins.description: Opens beside the Skills Customization window. Choose a route (your skill priorities, melee, ranged or magic gear first, vigor first, even progress for skills; best XP per hour, XP-boost drops or unfinished collections for slay mobs) and the levers worth pulling get a yellow outline with the number of steps, while levers that cost more than they give get an orange outline on their minus button. It counts your credits, including the refund when you lower a lever, and shows the expected gain. Nothing is pressed for you.
features: Routes for skills and for slay mobs
Yellow outline and step count on the levers to pull
Respects your credits and refunds
Display only: you press the levers

plugins.name: Drop Luck Tracker
plugins.author: Wulf
plugins.tagline: How lucky your rare drops have been, and a live Fortress run tracker.
plugins.description: Uses the kill counts and collection log the game already keeps. For each rare drop it works out the chance you would still be without it after your kills, adds them all up to rate your luck (very lucky to very unlucky, with the share of players you are ahead of), lists the most overdue drops first, shows every mob with its drops ticked off, and covers your unlock drops and skill pets. The Fortress tab follows your Fortress runs live (wave, your share of the army, the loot chance per tier, rares expected against rares got, the chance of at least one by now) and keeps a history you can open run by run. Opens from the ScapeLite button in the icon strip. Uses the published 1-in-N rates. Display only.
features: Luck rating from your real kill counts
Most overdue drops first
Every mob with its drops ticked off
Fortress tab: live run, luck verdict, drop log
Open any past Fortress run for its numbers
Nothing to log for mobs: uses the game's own counters

plugins.name: Goals
plugins.author: Wulf
plugins.tagline: What you are working towards and how long it takes at your real pace.
plugins.description: Shows the next level and the next milestone (a multiple of 5) of every skill you are training, with the XP left and the time left at your current XP per hour from the XP Tracker. It also lists unlock drops you do not have yet on mobs your Slay level lets you fight, with the expected time to get one from your real kill time; tools for skills you train come first. Pin your own skill targets and hunts to keep them on top. Opens from the ScapeLite button in the icon strip. Display only.
features: Next level and milestone for every skill you train
Time left at your real XP per hour
Unlock drops worth hunting, with expected time
Pin your own skill targets and hunts

plugins.name: Queue Walking Time
plugins.author: Wulf
plugins.tagline: See how long each queued task's walk takes, right on the queue.
plugins.description: Every queued task gets a thin bar along its top edge and a small tag such as 2m 31s: the walk to that task from the one before it, from the path distance the game prints next to the task and your walking speed. Longer walks give longer bars (a full bar is 5 minutes) and warmer colours, from green to red; purple means the game would teleport for that hop. Hover the tag for the exact steps. Display only; the queue itself is never moved.
features: Walking time on every queued task
Bar length and colour show how long the walk is
Purple for teleport hops
Never changes the queue layout

plugins.name: Raid DPS Extras
plugins.author: Wulf
plugins.tagline: Party total DPS and a damage graph for the Raid DPS panel.
plugins.description: Adds a Party line under the player rows (all players' damage and damage per second added together, with the run average) and a Graph tab beside DPS Current, DPS Total and Recap. The graph shows each player's DPS (averaged over 6 seconds) or total damage over time with a Party line, a hover read-out, and clickable names to hide a player. It only reads the numbers the panel already shows.
features: Party total DPS and damage
Per-player DPS and damage graph
Hover for exact values
Display only

plugins.name: Tree Advisor
plugins.author: Wulf
plugins.tagline: The best Delve and Fortress tree builds for your points.
plugins.description: Plans your Delve and Fortress (Fortify) trees. For the Delve tree it prices every node with the game's own Gear Calc damage maths on your equipped loadout, so a node's worth is shown as real DPS (and attacks per second) instead of a guess; goals for Delve XP, slayer and combat XP, balanced or your own weights are included, and the Fortress has skilling XP, Fortify XP and efficiency goals. It finds the exact best build for your points (a tree knapsack), shows what changes against your current build, the steps to get there (refund first, then take, in order), a picture of the tree with a tooltip on every node, and the option to keep your nodes and refund nothing. Builds can be saved, copied as text and imported again. Display only: it never allocates a node.
features: Exact best build for your points
DPS and attacks per second from the Gear Calc maths
Delve XP, slayer, balanced and custom goals
Fortress goals
Steps to switch, refund cost in credits
Save, export and import builds

plugins.name: Layout Editor
plugins.author: Wulf
plugins.tagline: Arrange every ScapeLite panel exactly how you like, and save the layout.
plugins.description: An edit mode for ScapeLite's own panels, opened from the ScapeLite menu. Drag any panel with snapping to the screen edges, to other panels and to a grid (hold Shift to move freely), resize it, scale it up or down, fade it with an opacity slider, or lock it so it cannot be dragged by accident. The whole arrangement is a named layout: keep several (for example one for questing and one for raids), switch between them, and export or import them as plain text. It only moves ScapeLite panels and never touches the game's windows.
features: Drag with snapping and guide lines
Opacity, scale and resize per panel
Lock panels in place
Named layouts with export and import
Show all panels while arranging

plugins.name: Info Bars
plugins.author: Wulf
plugins.tagline: Customisable top and bottom bars with the numbers you care about.
plugins.description: Bars along the top and optionally the bottom of the screen, like Titan Panel. Add modules (current task with progress and time left, location, XP per hour, gold, blood coins, clock, inventory space, hit points, alerts, active potions, panel buttons), drag them to reorder or move them to the other side or bar, and right-click for everything else: per-module options, bar height and opacity, moving or hiding a bar. The Hit points module shows numbers with an icon or a real colour-coded HP bar with an adjustable width and can hide the game's own HP bar. Hovering the Alerts module opens the alert list right there (the floating bell can be hidden). The bars are a real screen edge: the game and ScapeLite's panels fit into the space that is left, so nothing is hidden under them. Display only.
features: Task, location, XP/hr, gold, clock and more
Hit points as numbers or a coloured bar
Hover the Alerts module for the alert list
Drag modules to reorder
Right-click menus for modules and bars
Top and bottom bars; the game fits into the space left

plugins.name: Task Queue Panel
plugins.author: Wulf
plugins.tagline: Your task queue as compact cards: the current task plus all 7 queued ones fit at once.
plugins.description: The game's task queue redrawn as one compact card per task: an icon tile with the task's tier, the title and place, time and XP, and a colour-coded walking pill between the cards. Point at a task and its other options slide out to the side as small icon tiles; click one to use it. Drag a card to reorder the queue. The roll controls (Skilling / Slay, slayer master, credits, Auto loadout) fold into one slim line so more of the queue shows, and the cards and gaps are tight enough that the current task and all seven queued ones fit at the usual panel size. Quest, lucky and XP-boost tasks have their own colours, and the Route Advisor's highlight and recommended order show on the cards. It opens as a hover card on the info bar's Tasks button and stays open as a panel when you click the button.
features: Compact task cards with tiers and walking pills
Current task plus all 7 queued tasks in view
Roll controls fold into one slim line
Options slide out to the side; click to use one
Drag cards to reorder
Route Advisor highlight and recommended order

plugins.name: Chat Panel
plugins.author: Wulf
plugins.tagline: A roomier chat with Raid and Nearby kept apart and a colour-coded send list.
plugins.description: Shows everything the game's chat shows in a panel you can size as you like: channel tabs (Global, Nearby, Raid, Friends, Clan, Game) with unread counts, search, hide message types (level ups, tips, logins ...), highlight and mute words, timestamps with seconds or a 12-hour or 24-hour clock, font size, line spacing, background opacity, merged repeats and optional channel tags and badges. The game sends raid party chat on the same channel as everyone nearby; ScapeLite tells them apart by sender, so Raid messages get their own tab and colour. Hovering the channel button at the bottom opens a colour-coded list of the channels you can send to. The text you type is handed to the game's own chat when you press Enter. Messages and their channel and colour are kept across restarts.
features: Width, text size and spacing you choose
Global, Nearby, Raid, Friends, Clan and Game tabs
Colour-coded send-to list on hover
Search, highlight words, mute words
History and channel colours kept across restarts
Hide level ups, tips, logins and more

plugins.name: Panel Fusing
plugins.author: Wulf
plugins.tagline: Snap ScapeLite panels together so they move as one.
plugins.description: When two ScapeLite panels touch (the pinned cards, the Task Queue, the Chat) a small link button appears on their seam for a moment, and while you point at the seam. Click it and the panels fuse: they meet exactly with no gap, move together when you drag either one, keep their seam when the window is resized, and can open and close together (a switch in Settings and in each panel's title-bar menu). Unfuse the same way. Display only: it only moves ScapeLite's own panels.
features: Exact seams, no gap
Move and open or close as one
Link button only when it is useful
Survives window resizes and restarts

plugins.name: Fortress Drop Tracker
plugins.author: Wulf
plugins.tagline: Tracks your Fortress runs and how your drops compare with the odds.
plugins.description: Reads the Fortress HUD and the game chat and keeps its own history: every cleared wave is one roll at the loot chance the HUD showed for each tier, so it knows how many rares you were expected to see and how likely it was that you had none. Shows a live run (wave, your share against the game's 5% minimum, chances per tier), a luck verdict, a by-tier table, a drop and reward log and a history where every run opens into its own numbers.
